description: Source code for a PySide6 GUI widget class 'wgMeasurement' used for geometric measurements in the BORIS software, including UI setup, signal handling, and file saving functionality.

classes.name: wgMeasurement
classes.description: A QWidget subclass providing a GUI for geometric measurement tools, including options for point, distance, area, and angle measurements, with save and clear functionalities.

methods.name: pbClear_clicked
methods.description: Clears measurement drawings and results, emits clearSignal.

methods.name: pbClose_clicked
methods.description: Handles closing the widget, prompts to save if unsaved results.

methods.name: pbSave_clicked
methods.description: Saves measurement results to a text file if available.
